title: What Is Spec-Driven Development - Kiro · Spec Kit · BMAD | Complete Visual Guide #2
summary: Graphic-driven explainer of spec-driven development levels and the requirements/design/tasks document trio across Kiro, Spec Kit, BMAD and Claude Code.

assertions.quote: If the code and the spec disagree, the spec wins and the code is forced to change

verdicts.note: Specs help align agents, but code is still what runs; specs drift from implementation unless continuously maintained, and practitioners like Pocock report specs-only workflows failing.

assertions.quote: structure every requirement with a specific trigger and a measurable condition

verdicts.note: Checkable acceptance criteria give agents a stopping condition and give reviewers a test; out-of-scope lists reduce scope creep. Standard practice that carries over well to agents.

assertions.quote: They all expect these three exact pieces of information before they generate a single line of code

verdicts.note: Clear requirements, examples and references reliably improve agent output; the caveat is that bloated context can hurt, so curation matters.
